scripts.preview: npm run build -- --mode local-preview && vite preview --mode local-preview
scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && vite build
scripts.test:worker: vite build --mode local-preview --outDir dist/alarm-local-preview && vite build --mode worker-preview --outDir dist/worker-preview && npm run build && node --test --test-timeout=30000 test/worker/*.test.ts
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:worker
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build -- --mode worker-preview && wrangler preview --worker-name leaderboard-preview
